description: This plot illustrates the results of DPR using different expansion methods by representing the MRR@10 scores across a varying number of queries used during inference. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)." and uses a linear scale with plotted data ranging from 1 to 10, featuring numeric tick labels placed at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and features a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with numeric tick labels placed every 0.5 units. The plot contains four lines detailed in a legend located in the bottom right corner. The line representing "DPR w/o query" is a solid black line with no markers that remains perfectly flat at a constant value of approximately 34.25 across the entire x-axis from x=1 to x=10. The line for "DPR w/ corpus expansion" is a solid red line with circular markers. It begins at x=1 with a value of roughly 35.15, rises to approximately 35.55 at x=2, gradually reaches its highest peak at x=7 with a value around 35.80, and ends at x=10 with a value of approximately 35.78. The "DPR w/ document expansion" line is a solid green line with upward-pointing triangular markers. It starts at x=1 with a value around 34.78, exhibits a relatively steady trend with a minor peak at x=6 of about 34.93, and concludes at x=10 with a value near 34.84. The line corresponding to "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" is a solid blue line with star markers. It originates at x=1 with a value of approximately 34.75, fluctuates with peaks at x=2 (approximately 34.99) and x=5 (approximately 34.98), and undergoes a steady decline thereafter to finish at x=10 with its lowest value of roughly 34.38.
